title: Aegis Anti-Cheat
description: AegisAC is a high-performance, next-generation Minecraft anticheat built around a deterministic movement simulation engine. Designed with accuracy and reliability in mind, AegisAC validates player behavior by player movements
body:
AegisAC is a next-generation Minecraft anticheat designed to provide accurate, reliable, and scalable cheat detection through a combination of movement simulation, packet analysis, and behavioral heuristics.

Built around a deterministic movement engine, AegisAC validates every player action against the physical limits of Minecraft. By reconstructing player movement and comparing it to real packet data, the system can detect even subtle inconsistencies without relying on guesswork.

AegisAC offers comprehensive protection across multiple cheat categories. Movement-based exploits such as Fly, Speed, Step, Jesus, LongJump, Glide, and Velocity manipulation are detected through precise physics validation. The system also handles edge cases like cobwebs, fluids, ladders, and entity interactions to ensure consistent accuracy.

In combat, AegisAC identifies cheats including Reach, Aim assistance, AutoClicker, TriggerBot, KillAura, and Hitbox manipulation. By analyzing rotations, timing, and player interaction patterns, it can distinguish between legitimate gameplay and automated behavior.

For world interaction, AegisAC detects FastPlace, FastBreak, Scaffold, Nuker, and illegal block interactions such as AirPlace, GhostHand, and extended block reach. These checks combine timing analysis with movement context to prevent unnatural building or mining actions.

At the packet level, AegisAC provides high-precision detection of advanced exploits such as Timer, Blink, PacketFly, BadPackets, and desynchronization abuse. By working directly with packet data, the system achieves accurate timing analysis and reduces the risk of false positives.

Additional protections include detection of NoSlow, InventoryMove, FastUse, AutoTotem, rotation spoofing, and other niche exploits that are often overlooked but critical for maintaining fair gameplay.

AegisAC is built with performance in mind. Its asynchronous, multithreaded design allows movement checks and packet processing to run off the main server thread, ensuring minimal performance impact even with a large number of players.

To maintain accuracy under real-world conditions, AegisAC includes advanced latency compensation and per-player world replication. This ensures that all checks are evaluated based on what the player actually sees, eliminating false detections caused by lag or desynchronization.

Rather than relying on obscurity, AegisAC focuses on correctness and consistency. By combining simulation, packet analysis, and intelligent detection methods, it delivers a robust and future-proof anticheat solution suitable for modern Minecraft servers.
